Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats for TOP P2, P3, P4, P5 Delta, P5 Omega and P6, and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats for TOP P2 Party Synergy, TOP P3 Intermission, P3 Hello World, P3 Monitors, P4 Blue Screen, P5 Delta and P5 Omega, the P6 Gauntlet (all of P6 through the enrage, where you press your own limit breaks as LPDU assigns them), and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: Practice: Retry this roll (/noirmech retry) and Drill, which replays a failed roll after a 3 s look until you clear it. Auto-restart now rolls fresh every run. Your role, region, strat and settings are kept across restarts, and a Rotate role alternates MT/OT or M1/M2. NoirMech won't start while AnoMech is loaded. TOP P3 and P4 now play as real pulls do: Hello World towers land on the cardinals or the intercardinals, remote tethers break past 9 y, Omega's monitor hits his whole side, Blue Screen beams follow you, and timings are corrected. TOP P6 Gauntlet: R2's Meteor must be centred on Alpha Omega, tanks need their cooldowns at Cosmo Dive and Wild Charge while Require tank mitigation is on, and the last melee LB3 counts until the enrage hits.

Author: Noir Yamato
Name: MitCue
Punchline: Mitigation plan reminders, synced to the fight.
Description: Imports your raid's mitigation plan (Google Sheets or pasted text) and shows a small window telling you which of your actions to press next, synced to the boss. Reminder-only: it never presses anything for you.
Changelog: Copy AI prompt names your usual party slot only for the jobs of its role, and its example puts each job in a slot of its own role, so an AI that copies it no longer writes calls for a seat you never have on that job (a White Mage in MT, a Warrior in H1).
